resumeGalleryHint: Start from the resume gallery, then open a specific resume to edit.
resumeEditorHint: You are editing the current resume. Changes on the left sync to the live preview.
createResumeHint: Start from a blank resume or import an existing JSON resume file.
importResumeFailed: Import failed. Check the JSON file format.
searchResumesPlaceholder: Search by name, title, email, or phone
searchTemplatesPlaceholder: Search by template name or description
trashHint: Review deleted resumes and templates here, then restore or remove them permanently.
confirmDeleteResumeDescription: This resume will first be moved to the recycle bin and can still be restored there.
confirmDeleteResumesDescription: The selected resumes will be moved to the recycle bin together and can still be restored later.
confirmDeleteTemplateDescription: This template will first be moved to the recycle bin, and any resume using it will fall back to the default template.
confirmDeleteTemplatesDescription: The selected templates will be moved to the recycle bin, and resumes using them will fall back to the default template.
confirmDeleteResumeForeverDescription: This action cannot be undone. Make sure you no longer need this resume.
confirmDeleteTemplateForeverDescription: This action cannot be undone. Make sure you no longer need this template.
confirmEmptyResumeTrashDescription: All resumes in the recycle bin will be permanently removed and cannot be restored.
confirmEmptyTemplateTrashDescription: All templates in the recycle bin will be permanently removed and cannot be restored.
recycleBinHint: Deleted items are moved here first, where they can be restored or removed permanently.
unsavedChangesDescription: Unsaved changes: {count}. They will be lost if you leave.
exportFailed: PDF export failed. Confirm the backend export service is running and try again.
applyTemplateHint: Only affects this resume. It does not change the default template for newly created resumes.
loading: Loading resume data from the backend...
loadError: Failed to load remote data. Falling back to an empty resume.
editorHint: The shell now follows a shadcn sidebar layout and the editor is split into reusable feature components.
exportWarning: PDF exported, but some images were skipped
templatesHint: Switch templates and the A4 preview updates immediately. Export uses the active template.
templateGalleryHint: Start from the template gallery, then open a specific template to edit it.
templateManagerHint: Built-in templates are ready to use. Create custom templates to tune spacing, sizing, and density.
templateEditorHint: Edit template structure, styling, and decoration. Changes sync to the A4 preview in real time.
templateToolbarHint: Import template JSON files, remove one custom template, or bulk-delete selected ones.
templateImportFailed: Template import failed. Check the JSON format.
templateReadonlyHint: This is a system built-in template and can only be previewed. Create a copy to adjust layout, typography, colors, and decorations.
templatePreviewModulesHint: Adjust the modules used by the template preview. Real resume data is not changed.
templateDescriptionFallback: Add the intended role or usage notes for this layout in the template editor.
templateImagesEmpty: No extra image yet. Add a school logo, background texture, or placeholder, then tune its position and border.
modelsHint: Manage the configured LLM list with create, edit, and delete actions.
settingsHint: Manage website basics and agent behavior in one place.
siteSettingsHint: Configure UI language, theme, and login password.
siteThemeHint: Adjust the workspace theme or follow the system appearance.
agentSettingsHint: Configure default model, response language, confirmation, and suggestion style.
defaultAgentModelHint: Choose the LLM config the Agent uses by default.
agentResponseLanguageHint: Control which language the Agent uses in its suggestions.
agentBehaviorHint: Control how conservative or enhanced the Agent suggestions should be.
agentConfirmationModeHint: Control how Agent changes are confirmed after drafts are generated.
validationApiUrl: Enter a valid http(s) API URL.
validationTemperature: Enter a value between 0 and 1 in 0.1 steps.
emptyModelConfigs: No LLM has been configured yet.
modelConfigSideHint: These settings are loaded from the backend so you can switch across different LLM endpoints.
modelConfigSecurityHint: API keys are encrypted in SQLite. The backend .env stores only the master key.
modelConfigPopoverHint: Fill in the endpoint, API key, and sampling settings, then save it to the backend model list.
apiKeyOptional: Optional. When provided, the backend encrypts it before writing to SQLite.
basicSummary: Name, avatar, contact details, and custom fields
confirmDeleteSectionDescription: This removes the section and all entries inside it.
cropAvatarHint: Drag on the image to draw a crop box, move the box to reposition it, and use the bottom-right handle to resize.
cropAvatarGuide: The avatar will be cropped to the selected square area and compressed for more stable preview and PDF export.
aiHint: Parse the JD, find keyword gaps, optimize section phrasing, and sync the result into the live A4 canvas.
agentToolErrorObservation: Received a failed result; the next step will use it to correct course.
agentToolDefaultObservation: Received the tool result; the agent will use it for the next step.
agentTransientModelStatusTexts: I will analyze the target role and current resume first, then return actionable suggestions.
agentContextHint: Paste the target JD and the agent will suggest edits, apply changes, and list the knowledge you should prepare.
agentPromptPlaceholder: Paste a job description or ask what to fix first, which keywords are missing, and what knowledge to prepare.
agentPromptPlaceholderShort: What would you like to know?
agentPromptHint: Ask a question directly or paste a job description.
agentEmptyPrompt: I can help polish your experience and adjust your resume structure.
agentModelRequiredHint: The Agent needs a configured model. Add a model and API key before starting a chat.
agentPromptDisabledTooltip: Configure a model before starting a chat.
agentLogEmpty: No actions have been applied yet. Ask the agent to refine the summary, quantify experience, or fill keyword gaps first.
agentLogInitialQuestion: Review this resume as a whole first.
agentDraftSynced: The preview is showing the highlighted draft
agentDraftApplyHint: The preview is showing an Agent draft you can apply or discard.
agentReplySummary: I would start by sharpening the summary so it states the role direction, stack, and your strongest differentiators immediately.
agentReplyBullets: The project and internship entries need stronger outcomes, scale, and impact signals, so I would quantify the most important bullets first.
agentReplyKeywords: I would compare the JD with your resume, then write the missing keywords back into the title, summary, and experience naturally.
agentReplyKnowledge: Based on the JD and the current resume, I put together a shortlist of knowledge areas and examples worth preparing in advance.
agentReplyContextApplied: I treated this message as the active job description. I will use it for edit suggestions, keyword coverage, and preparation guidance from here.
agentReplyGeneral: I have reviewed this resume and can help on three tracks at once: expression polish, direct resume edits, and preparation guidance.
agentSuggestionMissingSummary: The opening summary can state the role focus, stack, and your advantage more directly.
agentSuggestionQuantify: The key experiences still need numbers, scale, or outcome metrics.
agentSuggestionProof: Prepare one or two proof points such as project depth, architecture choices, or portfolio links.
agentKnowledgeGapHint: Prepare this as a three-part answer: definition, your project example, and likely follow-up questions.
agentKnowledgeStoryHint: Turn this experience into a full story: context, goal, trade-offs, and result.
agentKnowledgeProofHint: Bring one concrete proof point with metrics, architecture detail, or collaboration evidence.
agentNoJobBrief: No target JD is pasted yet. I can give general resume guidance first, and the advice will become much sharper after you add a JD.
agentRequestFailed: Agent request failed. Confirm the backend service is running and try again.
agentAppliedSummary: I have already refined the summary toward the current role.
agentAppliedBullet: I have already rewritten the key experience into a more quantified style.
agentAppliedKeywords: I have already written the role keywords back into the resume.
scoreSummaryGood: The structure is solid and the main role signals are already covered.
scoreSummaryWeak: Add missing keywords and quantify results across project and internship entries.
richTextHint: Supports bold, italic, underline, and plain-text paste.
